messages:
Sam (CS): heads-up — Acme (customer) hit a 403 on the embeddings endpoint after rotating their API key a few hours ago. They pasted their request/response and say it used to work. Repro steps included below.

Sam (CS): their original cURL (redacted key):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings 
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk-live_***REDACTED***\" 
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" 
  -d '{"model":"open-embed-small","input":"hello world"}'
```

Sam (CS): response they saw:
```json
{
  "error": {
    "type": "insufficient_scope",
    "message": "missing required scope: embeddings.create",
    "status": 403
  }
}
```

Support Bot: Ticket #78921 created for Acme — priority P2. Assigned to customer-success queue. :ticket:

Raj P.: ok — looks like a classic scope mismatch after key rotation. Two quick checks: 1) confirm they didn't accidentally create a token with only `inference`/`chat` scopes, and 2) verify whether they generated an org-level token that has limited platform scopes.

Mia G.: Sam — can you ask for a screenshot of the API key detail page from Console > API keys? We need to see the `Allowed scopes` list (mask any token values). Also ask whether they used our SDK or raw HTTP.

Sam (CS): asked them for the screenshot and whether they used SDK; customer replies they used raw HTTP (curl) and created the key via Console -> API keys -> Create token -> selected "Inference" only (they thought embeddings were included). They attached the console screenshot showing a single checkbox "Inference (text/generation)" checked.

Raj P.: that confirms it — embeddings are gated by a separate scope. Historically people assume inference covers embeddings, but we split them. Action: tell customer to create a token with the Embeddings scope (or create a project-scoped key that includes both).

Mia G.: paste a small repro they can run after creating the new key.

Mia G.: reproducible cURL to share with Acme:
```
# replace <NEW_KEY> with token generated and ensure 'Embeddings' scope is selected
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings 
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer <NEW_KEY>\" 
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" 
  -d '{"model":"open-embed-small","input":["test"]}'
```

Eli T.: from an eng perspective — the API returns 403 + error type `insufficient_scope` which is technically correct but we've had recurring confusion. Two suggestions: 1) include a `required_scopes` array in the error payload (e.g., `["embeddings.create"]`) so callers know what to add, and 2) add a doc link in the error `docs_url` pointing to the API keys/scopes doc. I can put up a small patch for this week.

Raj P.: +1. Please add a brief copy change too that says: "Your key is missing the following scope(s): embeddings.create — generate a new key with Embeddings scope in Console." That will cut down on CS back-and-forth.

Eli T.: assigning to myself. I will:
- add `required_scopes` + `docs_url` to the 403 response for scope failures,
- create a small console UX note reminding users that Embeddings is a distinct scope when creating keys (copy only, not UX changes),
- add a unit test to validate error payload shape.
ETA: 48 hours for a PR, 1 week to ship.

Mia G.: Sam — can you send the customer these steps: regenerate token, ensure Embeddings scope selected, run the cURL above. If still failing, include the full response body (we need raw JSON).

Sam (CS): done — customer regenerated key with Embeddings scope and ran the curl. They confirmed success: 200 + embeddings vector returned. They also said it was confusing on Console where the scopes live.

Sam (CS): updated ticket #78921 with resolution, included the repro, and added a note to ask for improved error copy. Marking as pending eng PR for improved error payload.

Support Bot: Ticket #78921 status changed to "waiting on engineering" — linked PR # (will update when available).

Raj P.: follow-ups: 1) Eli please add the `required_scopes` as discussed, 2) product to consider a console hint, 3) CS to have a canned reply template for scope-mismatch 403s.

Eli T.: will open PR and ping here.

Mia G.: created a short draft reply for CS to reuse: 
> Hi — thanks for the report. The 403 with `insufficient_scope` usually means the API key was created without the Embeddings scope. Please generate a new key in Console > API keys and ensure "Embeddings" is selected. Then retry the request. If you still see a 403, paste the full response body here.

Sam (CS): sent the draft to customer, they're happy and confirmed the regenerated key fixed their integration. Closing after eng patch. :white_check_mark:

Eli T.: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4128 — adds `required_scopes` + `docs_url` on scope failures. Will link to release notes.

Raj P.: nice — thanks team. Learned item for docs. :memo:
